name: New Zealand Defence Force
description: New Zealand’s military organisation and a national user of geospatial intelligence.
story: The NZDF describes geospatial intelligence as operational support for navigation safety, intelligence mission data, imagery analysis and GEOINT mission management. Its 2019/20 reporting records GEOINT support during the Whakaari/White Island eruption, Tropical Cyclone Harold in Vanuatu and the COVID-19 response, including damage assessment, identifying areas and people needing assistance, and spatial, statistical and predictive analysis through tailored apps and dashboards.
GEOINT New Zealand sits within Defence Intelligence. The NZDF’s public organisation page links to its free GEOINT Data Service.
